test_title: PYST 14: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is:​

Option 1) NK−LI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5280c701b2fafb6b0fe0fba53f1c8cf504f0e95368fd10cc16a114ade71fd66a.png] 

Option 2) TQ−RO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/452686f8ede1ba6ea9f1ed0b9d6054e0f25d53e861d1a3113d295087efdcdcd2.png] 

Option 3) KH−HH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7feca81f9d72772dbafee7c1b7bd4961fdf5503cbea62795d7544ab68328f1b.png] 

Option 4) YV−WT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e228192f3e9d1972efc5c332258716873ba41318310832637064b8dd8b44e78d.png] 

Thus, out of all the options, 'KH−HH' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
